text: {"voice": 3, "model_prose": 3, "fidelity": 5, "note": "Keeps all eleven propositions with nothing of substance added, and its semicolons and inversions ('Of his inward thought...') gesture at the period manner, but the short, evenly weighted sentences, the semicolon-strung triad of actions and the aphoristic close sound more like a modern summary than the long, qualified periods of the samples."}
